name: Armend Belallari
bio: I'm a Senior Mobile Software Engineer at OpenResearch GmbH, with 13+ years experience in Mobile Development, passionate about building high-quality mobile applications and exploring emerging technologies. I work across Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, and Kotlin Multiplatform, focusing on scalable mobile architectures, AI-powered experiences, and developer productivity. I enjoy turning new ideas into working prototypes, experimenting with the latest Apple technologies, and sharing practical lessons learned with the developer community through talks, meetups, and hands-on demos.
